gate_review.proof_scope: Known-heavy exposed engineering mapping; no whole-axis qualification or independent-generalization claim.

action_and_feedback.support: one scalar lambda strictly sampled from bounded Beta on (0,1), physical curve defined by frozen axis
action_and_feedback.measure: d_lambda; no joint 18D or old 41D actor-density claim
action_and_feedback.deployment: conditional Beta mean mapped by the identical frozen axis
action_and_feedback.engineering_partial: censor entire four-arm paired batch, retain costs/proposals/RNG; no reward fabrication
action_and_feedback.hard_safety: any original true wins before censor/clock; unknown needs explicit original-evidence root resolution
action_and_feedback.JM: independent physical report, never arbitrarily combined with JF
action_and_feedback.controls: original B safe-anchor outside support; fixed lambda 0/.5/1 and original H150 same-axis performance controls, each actual rollout separately paid

initialization.seed_selection: root must freeze explicit integer initialization_seed and sampling_seed before activation; no best-seed choice
initialization.initialization_identity: SHA256 canonical JSON of exactly the ten backend initialization keys; auth binds this value

data_and_jobs.job_order: cold original OUTBOUND slot0 parent -> full-qualified original B -> four arms in registered order, two genuine independent fresh child rollouts each
data_and_jobs.first_job_inputs: all four CURRENT checkpoint path+file SHA
data_and_jobs.second_job_inputs: first closed job exact four pending checkpoint path+SHA, proposal/receipt/RNG state unchanged
data_and_jobs.root_sequence_wrapper: main owner will author and freeze new thin wrapper; original worker untouched
data_and_jobs.outcome_reuse: identical lambda/recipe outcomes never shared across arms or independent children
data_and_jobs.new_validation: future independent conditions require separate main contract; existing two development routes remain exposed development

clock_and_resources.clock_initialization: root-approved fixed initialized_unix/local_stop_unix; helper activation must occur within 60 seconds of that registered start
clock_and_resources.dispatch: main owner only, serial physical ownership; metadata helper never launches processes
clock_and_resources.candidate_names: up to ten two-case group pairs may be preregistered; each actual balanced batch requires a separate root current-pointer-bound approval
clock_and_resources.family_stop: unchanged local/global deadlines, hard safety, ability/engineering gates and resource reserve; not a fixed episode-number cap

transaction.real_runs_parent: precreate and fsync real_runs plus its parent; DurableRun alone creates actual new run and fsyncs parent before identity/intent/actor
transaction.publication: durable intent -> all four private drafts -> sealed exact computation bytes -> immutable generation -> atomic CURRENT
transaction.no_refit_recovery: existing intent rejects compute; recovery uses exact saved bytes without actor/adapter/optimizer imports
transaction.binding_requirements: only closed originals; exact pending object SHA; original START/END; per-actual-attempt main hard review backed by file SHA; no invented PASS or requestID
transaction.full_commit: two full jobs and original parentraw PASS; all receipt/old scalar logdensity/recipe/source/RNG chains revalidated by existing durable prepare
transaction.cancel: one/two closed partial jobs allowed with actual started-set and prefix evidence; no fabricated full B, ten STARTs or parentraw PASS; no RNG rewind

future_budget_accounting.authoritative_counters: actual per-arm forward/logpdf/gradient/sample/update/restore and failed-private-work counters, original physics START/END/native steps/CPU/RSS saved separately
